card.name: Concomitant use warning in opioid labels
card.fires_on: The word piece "itant" completing "concomitant" in the opioid-with-benzodiazepine warning. It also fires weakly on a few words in restless legs descriptions.

modes.label: concomitant warning
modes.description: Ending of "concomitant" in the warning about benzodiazepines or other CNS depressants with opioids.
modes.example: Profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death may result from the concom<<itant>> use of nalbuphine hydro

modes.label: restless legs wording
modes.description: Words in the description of the leg sensation and urge to move in restless legs syndrome.
modes.example: People with restless legs syndrome (RLS) experience an uncomfortable feeling in the legs, coupled<< with>> a strong compulsion to move the limbs

card.plain: It marks the end of the word "concomitant" in the standard opioid and benzodiazepine warning.
